links.comparator_used: Original patient-authored queries with user-level factors left in place (un-neutralized)
links.outcome: Differential diagnosis quality: plausibility, concision and clinician-likeness versus coverage of highly likely and safety-critical conditions
links.effect: No numbers reported in the abstract. Neutralization increases plausibility and yields more concise, clinician-like differentials, but reduces coverage of highly likely and safety-critical conditions.
links.tradeoff: Reduced coverage of highly likely and safety-critical conditions; the abstract describes Pareto-like tradeoffs across frontier LLMs.
links.quote: In particular, neutralization, which removes common user-level factors while preserving clinical content, increases plausibility and yields more concise, clinician-like differentials, but reduces coverage of highly likely and safety-critical conditions.

design_hint: input neutralization of patient queries (prompt-level rephrasing)
